tests.result_writer: PASS result frame storage + write arbitration: three zlib-verified frames, 1536 RGB565 pixels, concurrent capture bursts, whole-burst ownership/fairness, stalls, tag order, WLAST, timeout and reset recovery.
tests.read_arbiter: PASS DDR read arbitration: two simultaneous clients, 1/2/8/16-beat bursts, exclusive response routing, display urgency, fair whole-burst grants, address/response stalls, RLAST/RID faults, timeout, unsolicited data and reset recovery.
tests.frame_engine: PASS complete remap frame engine: identity/nonlinear/same-bank frames, 1536 independent integer-model pixels, locked parameters, shared display reads, CRC32 publication, bank overlap/alignment rejection, DDR stalls, malformed source response and mid-frame reset recovery.

output_format: RGB888 interpolation -> R/B high 5 bits, G high 6 bits -> RGB565 DDR frame
bank_policy: Aligned, non-overlapping source/output ranges; parent also locks display bank until release.
publish_policy: Only complete frame after ordered pixel storage and write drain; no faulted partial frame published.
limits: Integration simulation uses three 32x16 synthetic frames; no measured FPGA correction/FPS/latency or full-board timing pass.
